qt: "A queen should be seen, admired, but never touched." - Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
"A thief in the night, Draven did creep, families asleep, taken, held on high. Clever, he thought, 'til his children paid. Nay, villain, a man never bleeds alone."

"Be vigilant, Nezahul! When the serpent is cornered, does it give up? No... It waits. Then it bites the first hand it finds. The danger of numbers is all in your mind!" - Viper Napuatzi, instructing Royal Commander Nezahul
"Beyond fire, blood, and nightmare, the Saviour will build Utopia."
"Captain Hiff Greybeard accomplished what nary a Brinerot could: he died of old age. Almost had him a dozen times meself, if it weren't for that damn leg of his... crafty shite..."
"Focus. Hone your mind. Your lessers rely on the tangible. Shed your senses, and raze them from this physical realm."
"I like my vassals at sword point, but my enemies as close as the hilt." - Emperor Chitus
"Keep smiling. The deepest cut comes not from insults, but from false praise."
"Lundara held back the hordes, while Solerai rose to split the sky. With a single stroke, she ended the Winter of the World." - Wranga, tale-woman of the Wahida akhara
"Resist for long enough, and your oppressor will lose his will. Then, you've won."
"Soar. Be swift. Let none trespass here, from above or below, lest your purpose be forfeit."
"Stitches? Wouldn't that defeat the purpose?" - Jeffry, Torturer's Apprentice
"The heart is the herald. It will tell me when it is best to strike." - Atziri, Queen of the Vaal
"The ice seared his naked feet As the lightning stilled his heart, But it was the flames upon his lover's face That roused him to vengeance." - From 'The Three Dragons' by Victario of Sarn
"The sharper the pain, the sharper the mind. A curious paradox." - Shavronne of Umbra
"There is nowhere my vengeance cannot find you."
"Upon plains of endless chill, They Who Never Tire... dominate. They Who Never Surrender... terrify. And They Who Lay Beneath... wait for Nightfall." - Tul, She That Silences
"What lies beneath your feet?!" "Sacred ground, watered with tears of blood!"
"You think us savages?" mused the Red Wolf, as he pulled teeth from the Eternal's skull. "I will show your kind the way of tooth and claw."
"Your covetous hands bring the Unlight ever closer to consuming your realm."
A fell wind brings death.
A flash of blue, a stormcloud's kiss, her motionless dance the pulse of bliss
A gift, a braid, of golden hair. The war, forgotten. The reason, remembered.
A lightless world a silent reign two sightless eyes feed on your pain.
A swift mind solves problems before they occur.
A terror of ancient times, his identity remains lost... but his power does not.
A true predator does not chase; It waits.
A wall of steel and muscle.
A window onto a realm of red, where countless voices scream...
After the eruption, the skies turned grey, ash began to fall, and a chill set in...
All the world is my home.
All your tomorrows lie ahead of you, unknown and snarled to the very last.
An endless river of bodies lie in the wake of ambition.
An eye for an eye makes the whole world dead.
Ancient worshippers of the Greatwolf were overtaken by a ravenous hunger for all things mystical.
Anticipation is a gift.
As a boy, in the arena, Daresso learned to feign weakness to open up a lethal blow.
As the serpent shuns thought, It shuns fear. It strikes with the speed of wrath And the skill of compulsion.
Beyond madness lies inspiration.
Blessed are those who tend the Grove.
Blood shed is blood shared.
Bloodshed on the crimson shores, longing for the endless sea. Treasures, life, I'd give it all just to capture thee.
Brinerot pirates live in a perpetual blaze of glory, pushing their luck right to the end.
Captivity breeds creativity.
Centuries of servitude, a day of glory, an eternity of death.
Clever artifice is not always complex.
Cold, miserable and alone... but alive.
Dannig sculpted the Verisium to evoke the night-blooming lotus of Middengard's stygian peaks, which grow only where ash meets the snow and stars.
Diamora sings not for hunger, but for longing.
Familiarity breeds contempt.
Fight with the ferocity of the First Ones.
Fire dances with those who doubt Licks the skin and flesh from the fearful Where there is no fear There is no flame
For none of us are as cruel as all of us.
From aeons past, Dannig felt the Runefather's gaze, challenging him. There is no honour in ease. True greatness is torn from the jaws of defeat.
From the flesh of the gods, Xibaqua was born. From the carnage of Xibaqua, we were born. It is our duty to return to the gods what was once theirs.
Give him your body, and your burdens will follow.
Give of your heated passions. Give of your cold resolve. You will be repaid.
He never spoke a word. His opponents imagined their own personal mockeries, most cruel.
Heavy is the head.
In the end, even heroes fade away.
Let the rider's aim be true.
Lift it lightly, don it slow. The spikes point out and in, you know.
Light and shadow chase eternal, but neither knows the other exists...
Maligaro operated effortlessly, with great speed and terrible consequences.
Man retains sanity and strives toward civilisation only under the blessed veil of ignorance.
May you never hear it toll.
May your resolve never waver.
My bearer shall be guarded by flame, for I am the phoenix, forever radiant in glory.
Nature respects the strong And paints the snow red With the blood of the weak
No man burns alone.
No metal slips as easily through the fingers as gold.
Obedience stretches beyond the grave.
One warrior alone survived to face the Arbiter.
Only once did Maligaro wonder if he'd gone too far. His greatest success took three entire legions to capture.
Only the High Priests could enact the sacrifices, but all who witnessed shared in exultation.
Our hearts cry out but are silenced by our flesh and so we give up our flesh.
Pain brings clarity.
Praetor Draven knew his only chance to subjugate the Ezomytes was to catch them unaware.
Reality is a puzzle. Ingenuity is power.
Remaining unseen, the Dishonoured Assassin struck only in the depths of the harshest sandstorms.
Ride the western wind, and take flight.
She thinks and we act. She acts and we think. Fragments of the whole that washes clean the skies.
Sinuous, entwined... inextricable.
Some search forever for their path.
Sometimes patching up your equipment gets out of hand.
Tale-women do not fight as dekharas. They command a power all their own.
Tempest's power given form, Flee before the walking storm.
The Counts of Ogham share a legacy of cunning and power.
The Vaal emptied their slaves of beating hearts, and left a mountain of twitching dead.
The beasts we fear the most are the ones who dwell in total darkness.
The combat stance used by Vaal nobles was as elegant as it was deadly.
The cry of death whispers in the wind.
The cursed ones march forever, On their hopeless, last endeavour.
The darkest clouds clashed and coupled, giving birth to four lightning children of hate.
The devil finds work for idle hands.
The druids swore to protect the Grelwood with their very lives.
The end always comes sooner than we think.
The first Karui born on the fringes of the Vaal empire developed a blood fever born of corruption.
The greatest warrior of his era fought with honour.
The horrors we imagined as children still exist somewhere in the dark...
The largest beings on Wraeclast are not flesh and blood.
The mocking wind, a shielding spell, The haunting screams, a maddening hell
The older brother retained calm in the midst of fury.
The priests found the Great Shield the night it fell to Middengard, but it was the smiths who delved into the secrets it held.
The priests of the Kalguur keep faith through numbers and calculation, not unprovable promises.
The roar of the heavens Strikes more than fear Into the hearts of Man
The roots burrow deeper, unveiling the wood's bounty...
The secret was lost with its maker.
The seeds of greatness are planted in darkness, Watered by suffering, Tended by desperation, And bloom steel flowers of victory.

The sky tore asunder, black cleaving upon blue The end of life, of Time, with no escape But they found a fragment, a void, a haven And there they waited, as it all began again Dark will, dark knowledge, enemies of Fate They know your mind, because they remember
The spirit hungers for the flesh.
The storm cannot sway those of sure footing.
The strongest souls are forged through struggle and defeat.
The truly mighty are never outnumbered.
The unending carnage of war mercilessly grinds away at body and mind.
The whispers of the old gods hum through the iron. They demand a hero.
The younger brother waded into battle, shrugging off blows.
There was no hero made out of Starkonja's death, but merely a long sleep made eternal.
They screamed her name in adulation as they gave their very lives. She looked on with impatience.
Try as you like to hide the blood on your hands. You'll still know the truth.
Turning, gazing, blinking, behold the eyes of void. Burning, razing, drinking, your mind is destroyed.
Ulcers, scabs, and pocks, the third army makes its claim.
Unlike the other gods, when he was born from the volcano, Valako rode the clouds of ash into the thundering sky.
We may fight, and we may die, but in these moments of blood and battle, we truly live.
We move to be closer to her, but the distance yet grows.
Wealth is not to be borne lightly.
Welcome to Wraeclast.
What is worse, the sting of the past, the pain of the present, or the fear of the future?
When blood is paid, the weak think twice.
When the Red Sekhema called, the Ardura were the first to answer.
Where the body's limits begin, the mind's limits end.
While Doedre lacked Maligaro's sense of style, she surpassed her master in pure malevolence.
Why cling to your sanity? It offers you nothing. Surrender to me, and I will grant you everything.
Wonders abound at death's door.
Xibaqua's treachery was met with divine fury. One by one, the gods reclaimed their flesh, until all that remained was a droplet of pure light: The first Vaal.
You can be the wick or the wax. Either way, your light goes out and mine goes on.
"A man's soul rules from a cavern of bone, learns and judges through flesh-born windows. The heart is meat. The head is where the Man is." - Lavianga, Advisor to Kaom
